reasons.title: Customer/supplier concentration
reasons.text: Top 10 customers 84.0%; top 3 suppliers 70.2%; top 5 suppliers 75.0%. The top 3 suppliers alone account for 70.2% of purchases.

reasons.title: F19
reasons.text: 100% of the issue is an offer for sale by existing shareholders: that money goes to the sellers, not the company.

cleared_checks.title: Paper profits
cleared_checks.text: FY24: cash from operations ₹10.27 cr against profit after tax ₹12.06 cr (CFO/PAT 0.85).

cleared_checks.title: Lead manager track record
cleared_checks.text: INDORIENT FINANCIAL SERVICES LIMITED: 5 earlier SME IPOs with a known 6-month outcome before 2024-12-12; adjusted share that ended badly 0.04 against an average of 0.07.

cleared_checks.title: Watchlist link
cleared_checks.text: No party is linked to a SEBI order dated before 2024-12-12 (directly or through a lead manager's earlier issue).

cleared_checks.title: Drift between drafts
cleared_checks.text: 16 restated figures compared between the draft and the final prospectus. They match: no figure moved by 3% or more.

cleared_checks.title: Profit spike before the IPO
cleared_checks.text: Profit after tax FY24 ₹12.06 cr against an average of ₹10.07 cr in FY23-FY22 (1.2x).

cleared_checks.title: Eligibility gaming
cleared_checks.text: EBITDA by year: FY24 ₹20.79 cr, FY23 ₹19.41 cr, FY22 ₹14.83 cr; not clustered at the ₹1 cr floor.

cleared_checks.title: Auditor risk
cleared_checks.text: Statutory auditor Shah Mehta & Bakshi: 0 earlier SME IPOs with a known outcome, adjusted share that ended badly 0.07.

cleared_checks.title: Overvalued vs peers
cleared_checks.text: Issue P/E 26.8 against a median of 194.2 for the listed peers the RHP names (Crompton Greaves Power and Industrial Solutions Limited, Hitachi Energy India Limited, as printed in the RHP): 0.1x.

output.disclaimer: RedFlag gives a risk rating with evidence, not investment advice. It never says apply, avoid, buy or sell. Links to regulatory orders mean an entity was named in that order, not that this company did anything wrong.

agents.name: Intake
agents.role: Identifies the IPO and fixes as_of to its bid opening date

agents.name: Names
agents.role: Records the issuer, lead managers, auditor, market maker and registrar

agents.name: BankerTrackRecord
agents.role: Looks up the lead managers' earlier SME IPO outcomes known before as_of, through Zetaris, and computes the shrunk crash rate

agents.name: Watchlist
agents.role: Matches every named party against SEBI orders dated before as_of, directly and through one other entity

agents.name: Planner
agents.role: Chooses LIGHT, STANDARD or FORENSIC depth and escalates mid-run

agents.name: Extractor
agents.role: Reads the restated financials from the RHP: a deterministic table pass, then Nemotron mapping rows to fields when the numbers do not verify

agents.name: Specialists
agents.role: Computes F1-F3 and F5 (paper profits, profit spike, eligibility gaming, customer concentration) in code; F7 auditor risk from the archive

agents.name: NarrativeReader
agents.role: Reads the share capital history, peer comparison, objects of the issue and related-party transactions page by page with the Meterless Markovian engine (Nemotron), then computes F4, F8, F9 and F6 in code

agents.name: Skeptic
agents.role: Argues both sides of each ELEVATED or HIGH flag with Nemotron, citing RHP pages; applies the corroboration rule to HIGH flags

agents.name: Scorer
agents.role: Applies the backtested, calibrated model to compute_features (no LLM)

agents.name: Evaluator
agents.role: Checks coverage; sends gaps back to the Planner at most twice, else reports

agents.name: CitationVerifier
agents.role: Re-checks every cited page, query and order before the report is written

agents.name: Reporter
agents.role: Writes the report card and case_file.json from the Case File
